purpose: Screen bounded MultiSourceEdit capacity while preserving normal validation, cancellation and atomicity; allocation refusal timing changes as disclosed.

candidate_change.hint_policy: size_hint is advisory; clamp any reservation to remaining capacity and retain fallible growth

candidate_build.authorization: root separately authorized build after quality

cases.role: managed edit.set repeatedly through apply_batch([one item])
managed edit.set repeatedly through apply_batch([one item])
ordinary single-edit control and managed primary case

controls.scope: Focused iterator admission tests plus existing library suite; capture oracles independently verify output, semantic readback, inverse, resource counters and sink behavior. Not every oracle applies to every unit test.

environment.no_cargo_parallelism: one Cargo process; two internal build jobs; no Cargo during capture

screen_rule.eligible_signal: any named native primary or native peak RSS or allocator region peak live bytes candidate/baseline median ratio <= 0.95
screen_rule.primary_safety_stop: any native primary, native peak RSS, allocator region peak, or allocator peak RSS median > 1.05

root_screen_selector_controls.description: six synthetic boundary, invalid, no-signal, and safety-stop controls

confirmation.native: six fresh ABBA/BAAB blocks, 20 warmups, 200 samples per child
confirmation.allocator: three fresh AB/BA repeats, 2 warmups, 10 samples per child
confirmation.adoption_gate: named primary ratio <= 0.95, bootstrap CI upper < 1.0, no primary safety ratio > 1.05, all controls/oracles pass
additional_controls_required_before_adop: ordinary non-managed and fallback performance controls

runner_reducer.runner_family: 0960 serial fail-stop runner, freshly bound to this plan and root
runner_reducer.reducer_family: 0960 reducer/selector policy, schema-bound to this plan

estimated_serial_runtime.basis: 54 children and 2340 measured rows at one worker; no measured claim
